Name: Tiny Garden Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
does what it says on the tin — a very small cute little farm map (about one-third of the size of the vanilla ones)


[b]installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿
[*]download this mod and extract to Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]run the game with SMAPI and start a new save on the Forest Farm
[/list]

[b]configuration[/b]
[i]run the game once to generate config.json file in the mod folder. you can open it in any text editor
[/i]
[list]
[*][b]FarmToReplace[/b]: Standard, Riverland, Forest, Hilltop, Wilderness, FourCorners, or Beach (default Forest)
[*][b]EnableDecorations[/b]: true or false (default true) -- flower box, big tree, barrels, etc
[/list]
